fields.description: When enabled, the requestor gets an email each time their case is Approved, Declined, or Sent Back. Turn off to silence these notifications app-wide.
fields.label: Send Requestor Notification Emails

fields.description: When enabled, the requestor's own email (the "email"/"requestor_email" fields on the case registration web form) must be on the azimpremjifoundation.org domain. This never applies to approver emails in the Case Approval Stage table, which are always accepted as typed regardless of this setting.
fields.label: Enforce Email Domain Validation

fields.description: When enabled, every field marked mandatory on the Case Register doctype, and on its Supporting Documents/Family Members child tables, becomes genuinely optional everywhere — the Desk form, the public web form, and a Frappe Data Import all stop requiring them. This edits the actual field definitions (via Property Setters), not just one save path, so turn it off again once you're done importing historical data to restore normal validation for everyone.
fields.label: Disable Case Register Mandatory Fields
